    Summand criterion in the thick subcategory generated by a presilting object #

    Lemma 7.4 (lem:presilting-summand, after Garcia) of the manuscript: in any triangulated category, if P has no positive self-extensions and L ∈ thick(P) satisfies Hom(P, L[n]) = 0 = Hom(L, P[n]) for all n > 0, then L ∈ add(P) (isInAdd_of_mem_thick).

      An object of the thick subcategory generated by a presilting object belongs to its additive closure if the positive shifted Hom groups vanish in both directions. This holds in any triangulated category.
